revision_notes.title: Ideas in exploration
revision_notes.lede: Revise models, laws and theories before your examination.

1.name: Models
1.definition: A model is a simplified representation.

content.summary: A scientific model is a simplified representation of a real system that ignores some details on purpose. A law describes a repeated pattern, and a theory explains why patterns occur. Together they show how scientists describe and explain what they find.

topics.name: Models
topics.gist: What a model is and why it ignores some details.

topics.name: Laws and theories
topics.gist: What a law and a theory are, and how they differ.

remedial.title: Ideas in exploration
remedial.lede: Learn Ideas in exploration one small step at a time, at your own pace.

1.name: Models
1.definition: A model is a simplified representation.

method.label: Start from what you know
method.text: Each unit begins with the ideas it builds on, so you can see what to look at again first.

method.label: Say it in plain words
method.text: The idea is explained in short sentences and everyday words before any technical wording.

method.label: Take it step by step
method.text: The idea is broken into small steps. Take them one at a time, in order.

method.label: See it worked
method.text: Where the chapter has an example, it is worked through slowly, with the reason for each step.

method.label: Watch for the mistakes
method.text: The mistakes learners often make are named, with why they do not hold and what is true instead.

method.label: Practise, then check yourself
method.text: Practice starts with a hint and gets harder. Then you go back to the steps if you need to.

content.simple_explanation: A scientific model is a simple picture of something real. It keeps what matters and leaves some details out.

steps.label: Add the detail

steps.label: Put it together
steps.text: The result is a simplified representation.

mistakes.correct_idea: A model is a simplified representation of a real system.
